summary: Busy through road with no parked cars, houses 8 m from kerb.

best_section.where: Bellevue Parade west kerb, uphill from the side street junction

drivers.seclusion: Houses sit 8-14 m from the kerb along the whole stretch, with a pool and apartments nearby.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow verge beside a busy lane; no pull-off and no parked cars to share the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Busy multi-lane road with a signalised-style junction at the end.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along this kerb in either image; no parking lane marked.

sun_shade: Mostly open; trees shade the east side in the morning.
